English.Char_Desc_250: AnyMusic is an MP3 downloader supporting 1,000+ websites. It offers MP3, M4A, and WAV downloads at up to 320kbps, with metadata and cover art automatically added. Batch downloads and playlist support make it easy to save multiple tracks at once.
English.Char_Desc_450: AnyMusic is an MP3 downloader for Mac that supports 1,000+ websites, including YouTube, SoundCloud, TikTok, and more. It lets you download MP3, M4A, or WAV files at up to 320kbps, with metadata and cover art automatically added. You can find music by artist, song, album, or lyrics, or paste a URL to download it directly. Batch download multiple tracks or entire playlists to save time.
English.Char_Desc_2000: AnyMusic is an MP3 downloader for Mac that makes it easy to find and save music from more than 1,000 websites. It supports popular platforms such as YouTube, SoundCloud, TikTok, and more, giving you a convenient way to manage music from different sources in one place. You can download music in MP3, M4A, or WAV formats with quality options of up to 320kbps. When downloading music, AnyMusic can automatically add metadata and cover art to your audio files, making it easier to organize and identify your music library. Finding music is simple. Search by artist, song, album, or lyrics to locate the track you want, or paste a music URL to download it directly. You can preview tracks before downloading to make sure you have selected the right content. AnyMusic also makes it easy to handle multiple downloads. Batch downloading lets you save multiple tracks at once, while playlist support allows you to download an entire playlist without processing each song individually. This is especially useful when you want to build a music collection or save several tracks from the same source. In addition to music, AnyMusic supports music video downloads in MP4 format, giving you more flexibility when saving content from supported websites. The app is designed with a straightforward interface, so you can search, select the format and quality you want, and manage your downloads without complicated steps.
